explication: jsPDF is a JavaScript PDF-generation library. A caller imports the public entry, creates a document, adds text, graphics, images or richer document features, then serializes or saves the PDF. The tree and README establish broad plugin capabilities; sampled source confirms the entry’s plugin loading, core file-saving behavior, and several integrations, but not every plugin’s runtime call path, so uncertain links are omitted.
